description: A Node.js and Express backend that batches comment notifications into one daily digest email per user with a Courier journey's Batch node.
rules: Use the @trycourier/courier SDK and read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment, on the server only.
Define the journey (API trigger, per-user Batch node, email send node) in code with client.journeys.create, replace, and publish.
Call client.journeys.invoke once per event, with an Idempotency-Key built from the event's database id.
Batch wait_period is 1 minute to 1 day, and max_wait_period is at least wait_period and at most 7 days. Use PT1M to test.
Connect the email provider (Resend, SendGrid, Postmark) in Courier instead of calling it directly.
